name: calpain 1

function.text: CAPN1 encodes calpain-1 catalytic subunit. Annotated molecular activities include peptidase activity and calcium-dependent cysteine-type endopeptidase activity. It participates in regulation of catalytic activity and proteolysis.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to autosomal recessive spastic paraplegia type 76 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: The gene appears in specialty educational coverage, but a disease-specific somatic driver relationship has not been assigned in this draft; expression-marker or assay-context mentions are not mutation evidence.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; strong GenCC assertion from Ambry Genetics. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
